assignedReviews.card_evidence: Natural rubber comes from the white sap (latex) of the rubber tree!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some useful things that people have made from non-living materials and describe what natural materials have been used to make the items
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about useful things made from non-living materials (earth materials). Rubber from tree sap is a product of a living organism (the rubber tree), not a non-living material. The card does not support identifying useful things made from non-living materials.

copy.en: Natural rubber comes from the white sap (latex) of the rubber tree! The bark is cut, the dripping sap is collected, then hardened into rubber.
copy.tl: Ang likas na goma ay galing sa maputing dagta (latex) ng puno ng goma! Tinatapyasan ang balat, iniipon ang tumutulong dagta, at pinapatatag para maging goma.
copy.bis: Ang natural nga goma gikan sa puti nga dagta (latex) sa kahoy nga goma! Ginasamaran ang panit, ginatigom ang nagtulo nga dagta, dayon gipagahi aron mahimong goma.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Different rulers or tapes are suited for different objects.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different types of volcanoes found around the world according to their: a. activity b. type of eruption c. location in the crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses measuring tools (rulers and tapes) and has no content about volcanoes, their activity, eruption types, or crustal location. It does not support any part of the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Different rulers or tapes are suited for different objects.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about choosing appropriate measuring instruments, not about what volcanoes are or how they are formed. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
Can one ruler measure everything?

No! Different rulers or tapes are suited for different objects. A short ruler works for a pencil, but a long tape measure is better for a cabinet.
copy.tl:
Kaya bang sukatin ng isang ruler ang lahat?

Hindi! Iba't ibang ruler o tape ang bagay sa iba't ibang bagay. Ang maikling ruler ay para sa lapis, pero mas bagay ang mahabang tape measure sa cabinet.
copy.bis:
Makasukod ba ang usa ka ruler sa tanang butang?

Dili! Ang lain-laing ruler o tape angay sa lain-laing butang. Ang mubo nga ruler para sa lapis, pero mas maayo ang taas nga tape measure sa cabinet.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: S waves have a velocity of about 3 to 4 kilometers per second
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and record changes in the weather during a day or over some days and describe the different types and patterns of weather in the local area
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the velocity of seismic S waves, a topic about Earth's interior and earthquake waves. G3-E-4 is about observing and recording weather changes and describing local weather patterns. There is no connection to weather; the card is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: S waves have a velocity of about 3 to 4 kilometers per second, which is slower than P waves.
copy.tl: Ang S waves ay may bilis na mga 3 hanggang 4 na kilometro bawat segundo, na mas mabagal kaysa P waves.
copy.bis: Ang S waves adunay kakusog nga mga 3 hangtod 4 ka kilometro kada segundo, nga mas hinay kaysa P waves.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sounds below 85 decibels - the unit used to measure loudness - are considered safe for our hearing
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models and labeled diagrams to represent the double helix structure of DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid)
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about safe sound/decibel levels and hearing protection, which is unrelated to the G9-L-1 competency on using models and labeled diagrams to represent the double helix structure of DNA.

copy.en: Sounds below 85 decibels - the unit used to measure loudness - are considered safe for our hearing, like normal talking or a quiet room.
copy.tl: Ang mga tunog na mas mababa sa 85 decibels - ang yunit na ginagamit sa pagsukat ng lakas ng tunog - ay ligtas para sa ating pandinig, tulad ng normal na pag-uusap o tahimik na silid.
copy.bis: Ang mga tingog nga mas ubos sa 85 decibels - ang yunit nga gigamit sa pagsukod sa kakusog sa tingog - luwas alang sa atong pandungog, sama sa normal nga pag-istorya o hilom nga kwarto.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: For the safety of our environment, so that our surroundings stay clean and healthy for everyone!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe using labeled diagrams the biotic and abiotic features of tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses changing materials into useful products for environmental safety. It does not describe biotic or abiotic features of any ecosystem, nor does it use labeled diagrams. The competency is about tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs, which are not mentioned.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: For the safety of our environment, so that our surroundings stay clean and healthy for everyone!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe living things, such as animals and plants, as biotic factors and light, water, temperature, and soil type, as abiotic factors in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about material changes and environmental cleanliness, not about describing living things as biotic factors or non-living things as abiotic factors in an ecosystem. No ecosystem or factor classification is present.

copy.en:
Why do we need to change materials into useful products?

For the safety of our environment, so that our surroundings stay clean and healthy for everyone!
copy.tl:
Bakit kailangan nating baguhin ang mga materyales para maging kapaki-pakinabang na produkto?

Para sa kaligtasan ng ating kapaligiran, upang manatiling malinis at malusog ang ating paligid para sa lahat!
copy.bis:
Ngano nga kinahanglan nato nga bag-ohon ang mga materyales aron mahimong mapuslanong produkto?

Alang sa kaluwasan sa atong kinaiyahan, aron magpabilin nga limpyo ug himsog ang atong palibut alang sa tanan!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Salt is a mineral that is used to make food taste better and to keep food fresh.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models, flow charts, diagrams, and simulations to explain how body systems work together, such as digestion and excretion
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires using models, flow charts, diagrams, or simulations to explain how body systems work together (e.g., digestion and excretion). The card only states that salt is a mineral used for flavoring and preserving food; it provides no information about body systems or their interactions. This is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Salt is a mineral that is used to make food taste better and to keep food fresh.
copy.tl: Ang asin ay isang mineral na ginagamit upang gawing mas masarap ang pagkain at upang mapanatiling sariwa ang pagkain.
copy.bis: Ang asin usa ka mineral nga gigamit aron mas lami ang pagkaon ug aron magpabiling presko ang pagkaon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Waves do not create energy from nothing as they travel.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify differences and similarities between longitudinal waves and transverse waves
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that waves carry energy from a source and do not create energy. It does not mention longitudinal waves, transverse waves, or any differences/similarities between them, which is the exact subject of G6-F-7.

copy.en: The energy they carry comes from the source! Waves do not create energy from nothing as they travel.
copy.tl: Ang energy na dala nila ay galing sa source! Hindi nakakalikha ng energy ang waves mula sa wala habang naglalakbay.
copy.bis: Ang energy nga ilang gidala naggikan sa source! Dili makagama og energy ang mga balod gikan sa wala samtang naglihok.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Homozygous individuals have two identical alleles for a trait, while heterozygous individuals have two dissimilar alleles for that trait.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines homozygous and heterozygous alleles, which is genetics content. G6-M-6 is about separating mixtures (decantation, filtering, etc.), completely unrelated to alleles.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Homozygous individuals have two identical alleles for a trait, while heterozygous individuals have two dissimilar alleles for that trait.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about genetic allele pairs, not changes of state of matter (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation). No connection to G6-M-1.

copy.en: Homozygous individuals have two identical alleles for a trait, while heterozygous individuals have two dissimilar alleles for that trait.
copy.tl: Ang homozygous na indibidwal ay may dalawang magkaparehong alleles para sa isang katangian, habang ang heterozygous ay may dalawang magkaibang alleles para sa katangiang iyon.
copy.bis: Ang homozygous nga indibidwal adunay duha ka parehas nga alleles para sa usa ka kinaiya, samtang ang heterozygous adunay duha ka magkalahi nga alleles para niana nga kinaiya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Why must solute and solvent have the same unit before adding?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains why solute and solvent must share the same unit when calculating mass percent. This is a chemistry/concentration concept and has no relation to volcanoes or their formation, which is the subject of G6-E-1.

copy.en:
Why must solute and solvent have the same unit before adding?

Because you cannot add grams and kilograms directly! One unit must be converted first so the mass of solution is correct.
copy.tl:
Bakit dapat magkapareho ang unit ng solute at solvent bago pagdagdagin?

Dahil hindi mo maaaring direktang pagdagdagin ang gramo at kilogramo! Kailangang i-convert muna ang isang unit para tama ang mass ng solution.
copy.bis:
Ngano kinahanglang pareho ang unit sa solute ug solvent sa dili pa dugangan?

Tungod kay dili nimo direktang madugang ang gramo ug kilogramo! Kinahanglang i-convert una ang usa ka unit aron husto ang mass sa solution.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The sampaguita was declared the national flower of the Philippines way back in 1934.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a table to show how living things can be classified into groups based on similar characteristics (plants including flowering and non-flowering; animals including mammals, reptiles, insects, birds, fish, amphibians; microorganisms including fungi and bacteria)
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states a historical fact about the sampaguita being declared the national flower. It does not classify living things into groups based on similar characteristics, nor does it use a table as required by the competency. The content is unrelated to the classification skill.

copy.en: The sampaguita was declared the national flower of the Philippines way back in 1934.
copy.tl: Idineklara ang sampaguita bilang pambansang bulaklak ng Pilipinas noong 1934.
copy.bis: Ang sampaguita gideklara nga nasodnong bulak sa Pilipinas niadtong 1934.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The San Andreas Fault in California, USA is an example of a transform fault boundary on a continent.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to identify examples of modern biotechnology, such as genetically modified organisms and processes (e.g. in vitro fertilization)
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a geological transform fault boundary, with no mention of modern biotechnology, genetically modified organisms, or in vitro fertilization.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the term biotechnology and provide examples
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not explain biotechnology or provide any biotechnology examples; it is entirely about a geological fault.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The San Andreas Fault in California is a well-known strike-slip fault where the Pacific Plate slides past the North American Plate.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use proper techniques in observing and identifying the parts of a cell with a microscope such as the cell membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, mitochondria, and chloroplasts
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a geological fault (San Andreas Fault) and plate motion, which is unrelated to the competency about using a microscope to observe cell parts. No cell biology content is present.

copy.en: The San Andreas Fault in California, USA is an example of a transform fault boundary on a continent.
copy.tl: Ang San Andreas Fault sa California, USA ay isang halimbawa ng transform fault boundary sa isang kontinente.
copy.bis: Ang San Andreas Fault sa California, USA usa ka pananglitan sa transform fault boundary sa usa ka kontinente.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sand has a coarse or grainy texture because its particles are large enough to feel individually, like tiny rocks.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe air as a mixture of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and water vapor
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the physical texture of sand particles. G6-M-5 requires describing air as a mixture of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and water vapor; sand texture provides no instructional support for that competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sand has a coarse or grainy texture because its particles are large enough to feel individually, like tiny rocks.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a physical textural property of sand, not a chemical property such as being burnt, reacting with other materials, or being degradable/biodegradable. It does not support G4-M-3.

copy.en: Sand has a coarse or grainy texture because its particles are large enough to feel individually, like tiny rocks.
copy.tl: Magaspang o grainy ang texture ng sand dahil sapat ang laki ng mga particles nito para maramdaman nang isa-isa, parang maliliit na bato.
copy.bis: Bagis o grainy ang texture sa sand tungod kay igo ang kadako sa mga particles aron mabati nga tagsa-tagsa, sama sa gagmay nga bato.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cleaning or sanitizing the surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: predict and explain whether heavier objects will fall faster than lighter objects due to the force of gravity
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses cleaning/sanitizing surfaces to kill germs and avoid viruses. It has no connection to gravity, falling objects, or predicting whether heavier objects fall faster. The competency is about gravity, which is entirely unrelated to the card's content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cleaning or sanitizing the surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the effects of gravity to the motion of an object
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about hygiene and preventing viruses, not about observing or describing the effects of gravity on the motion of an object. There is no instructional support for the gravity competency.

copy.en: Cleaning or sanitizing the surface of non-biodegradable materials we always touch helps kill germs and avoid viruses.
copy.tl: Ang paglilinis o pag-sanitize sa surface ng mga non-biodegradable na materyales na lagi nating hinahawakan ay nakakatulong para patayin ang mga mikrobyo at maiwasan ang mga virus.
copy.bis: Ang paglimpyo o pag-sanitize sa surface sa mga non-biodegradable nga materyales nga kanunay natong hikapon makatabang aron patyon ang mga kagaw ug malikayan ang mga virus.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: measure plate movement from orbit
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the life cycles of mammals from birth to adulthood, birds from egg to a mature organism, and plants from seed to a young plant, and then to a mature plant
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes satellites measuring plate movement, which is a geoscience/geodesy topic. It has no relation to comparing life cycles of mammals, birds, or plants.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: measure plate movement from orbit
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about satellite-based measurement of plate movement, not about specialized structures in plants such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, or aerial roots.

copy.en: A satellite is a machine launched into space that moves around Earth, and satellites carry instruments that measure plate movement from orbit.
copy.tl: Ang satellite ay isang machine na inilunsad sa space na umiikot sa Earth, at nagdadala ito ng mga instrumento na sumusukat sa plate movement mula sa orbit.
copy.bis: Ang satellite kay usa ka makina nga gilunsad sa kawanangan nga molibot sa Earth, ug nagdala kini ug mga instrumento nga nagsukod sa plate movement gikan sa orbit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A saturated solution has dissolved as much solute as it can hold at a given temperature
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that momentum is conserved before and after the collision of objects
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes saturated solutions, a chemistry/solubility concept. G10-F-8 is about conservation of momentum in collisions, which is unrelated to the card content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A saturated solution has dissolved as much solute as it can hold at a given temperature
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different types of collisions as elastic or inelastic by providing some examples
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes saturated solutions, not elastic or inelastic collisions. G10-F-2 is a physics competency about collision types, with no connection to the card's chemistry content.

copy.en: A saturated solution has dissolved as much solute as it can hold at a given temperature, so any extra solute settles at the bottom.
copy.tl: Ang saturated solution ay nakatunaw na ng pinakamaraming solute na kaya nitong hawakan sa isang temperatura, kaya ang sobrang solute ay naiipon sa ilalim.
copy.bis: Ang saturated solution nakatunaw na sa pinakadaghang solute nga kaya niyang huptan sa usa ka temperatura, mao nga ang sobra nga solute magpundo sa ilawom.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the first is a scalar quantity - it only has magnitude ... The second is a vector quantity - it has both magnitude and direction
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Scalar vs vector quantities are physics, not plant reproduction.

copy.en:
Why do we say "5 kilometers" is not enough when giving directions?

Because distance is a scalar — it only tells the size. A vector like "5 kilometers north" adds direction, so you actually know where to go!
copy.tl:
Bakit hindi sapat ang "5 kilometers" kapag nagbibigay ng direksyon?

Dahil ang distance ay scalar — size lang ang sinasabi nito. Ang vector tulad ng "5 kilometers pahilaga" ay may dagdag na direksyon, kaya alam mo kung saan pupunta!
copy.bis:
Ngano dili paigo ang "5 kilometers" kon maghatag ug direksyon?

Tungod kay ang distance kay scalar — size lang ang gisulti. Ang vector sama sa "5 kilometers paamihanan" naay dugang nga direksyon, mao nga kabalo ka asa moadto!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scavengers, people who search through waste to find recyclable materials
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes scavengers collecting recyclables from garbage, which is a social/environmental topic. G10-E-2 requires describing structures, movements, and events at plate boundaries (plate tectonics). There is no connection to Earth science or plate boundaries.

copy.en:
Who collects recyclable items from dumped garbage?

Scavengers, people who search through waste to find recyclable materials, collect these items as their only source of income.
copy.tl:
Sino ang nangongolekta ng mga recyclable na bagay mula sa itinapong basura?

Ang mga scavenger, mga taong naghahanap sa basura para makakita ng recyclable materials, ang nangongolekta ng mga ito bilang kanilang tanging pinagkukunan ng kita.
copy.bis:
Kinsa ang mangolekta sa mga recyclable nga butang gikan sa gilabay nga basura?

Ang mga scavenger, mga tao nga nangita sa basura aron makakita ug recyclable materials, ang mangolekta niini isip ilang bugtong tinubdan sa kita.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Schrodinger's quantum mechanical model describes electron energies and probable locations around the nucleus
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: collaborate in a class discussion to recognize the advantages and limitations of using series or parallel circuits
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the quantum mechanical model of the atom, which is unrelated to the competency about recognizing advantages and limitations of series or parallel circuits. No electrical circuit content is present.

copy.en: Schrodinger's quantum mechanical model describes electron energies and probable locations around the nucleus, showing them as a cloud of negative charges.
copy.tl: Ang quantum mechanical model ni Schrodinger ay naglalarawan ng mga energy ng electron at probable locations sa paligid ng nucleus, na ipinapakita ang mga ito bilang ulap ng negative charges.
copy.bis: Ang quantum mechanical model ni Schrodinger naghulagway sa mga energy sa electron ug probable locations libot sa nucleus, nga nagpakita kanila isip panganod sa negative charges.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about environmental problem-solving and material properties, with no mention of waves carrying energy from a source to a receiver. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Science can be used to identify environmental problems and find solutions by applying knowledge about the properties of materials.
copy.tl: Ang science ay maaaring gamitin para matukoy ang mga problema sa kapaligiran at makahanap ng solusyon sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng kaalaman tungkol sa properties ng mga materyales.
copy.bis: Ang science mahimong gamiton aron mailhan ang mga problema sa kinaiyahan ug makakita og solusyon pinaagi sa paggamit sa kahibalo mahitungod sa properties sa mga materyales.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The scientific method is a step-by-step procedure that helps researchers organize ideas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the scientific method, which is unrelated to observing the root and shoot system in plants or describing their importance. No plant anatomy or function is mentioned.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the changes of state in terms of particle arrangement and energy changes: a. solid → liquid → vapor, and b. vapor → liquid → solid

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the scientific method, not about melting, evaporation, freezing, or condensation, and does not use diagrams or flowcharts.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The scientific method is a step-by-step procedure for solving scientific problems
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not address heat energy or changes of state at all.

copy.en: The scientific method is a step-by-step procedure for solving scientific problems, from identifying the question to sharing the answer.
copy.tl: Ang scientific method ay isang hakbang-hakbang na paraan para lutasin ang mga scientific problem, mula sa pagtukoy ng tanong hanggang sa pagbabahagi ng sagot.
copy.bis: Ang scientific method usa ka sunod-sunod nga pamaagi sa pagsulbad sa mga scientific problem, sugod sa pagpangita sa pangutana hangtod sa pagpaambit sa tubag.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Baking soda is called sodium bicarbonate, and vinegar is called acetic acid
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different types of volcanoes found around the world according to their: a. activity b. type of eruption c. location in the crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the scientific names of kitchen materials (chemistry), not volcano types, eruption types, or crustal location.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Baking soda is called sodium bicarbonate, and vinegar is called acetic acid
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: relate the shape of a volcano's cone to its composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card has no relation to volcano cone shape or composition; it is about chemical names of household substances.

copy.en: Baking soda is called sodium bicarbonate, and vinegar is called acetic acid, which are the scientific names for these everyday kitchen materials.
copy.tl: Ang baking soda ay tinatawag na sodium bicarbonate, at ang suka ay tinatawag na acetic acid, na siyang mga scientific name ng mga pangkaraniwang gamit sa kusina.
copy.bis: Ang baking soda gitawag ug sodium bicarbonate, ug ang suka gitawag ug acetic acid, nga mao ang mga scientific name niining ordinaryong gamit sa kusina.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The pitch of a screw is the distance between two neighboring threads
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify evidence of global warming and climate change
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines screw pitch, a simple-machines/mechanics concept. G10-E-8 requires identifying evidence of global warming and climate change. There is no overlap in subject matter.

copy.en: The pitch of a screw is the distance between two neighboring threads, and a smaller pitch means the screw turns more times to go in.
copy.tl: Ang pitch ng screw ay ang distansya sa pagitan ng dalawang magkatabing thread, at mas maliit na pitch ay nangangahulugang mas maraming ikot ang screw para pumasok.
copy.bis: Ang pitch sa screw mao ang distansya tali sa duha ka magtapad nga thread, ug mas gamay nga pitch nagpasabot nga mas daghan ang tuyok sa screw aron mosulod.

copy.bis: Ang Sustainable Development Goal 14 nagtutok sa konserbasyon ug sustainable nga paggamit sa biodiversity sa marine ug coastal ecosystems.

assignedReviews.reason: Card describes sebum, a skin secretion, with no relation to plate boundaries, their structures, movements, or events.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the types of plate boundaries found around the Earth

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify how oceanic crust and continental crust is associated with the Earth's lithospheric plates
assignedReviews.reason: Card discusses sebum and skin glands, unrelated to oceanic/continental crust and lithospheric plates.

copy.en: The skin's natural oil is called sebum, released by glands to keep the skin moisturized and protected.
copy.tl: Ang natural na langis ng balat ay tinatawag na sebum, inilalabas ng mga glands para manatiling moisturized at protektado ang balat.
copy.bis: Ang natural nga lana sa panit gitawag ug sebum, gipagawas sa mga glands aron magpabilin nga moisturized ug protektado ang panit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The secondary colors are green, orange, and purple.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided science activities to explore and describe sources of light, how it behaves or can be changed, and its uses in everyday situations
assignedReviews.reason: The competency concerns sources of light, how light behaves or can be changed, and its uses. The card discusses secondary colors formed by mixing primary colors, which is about pigment/color mixing, not light behavior. It does not support the competency.

copy.en: The secondary colors are green, orange, and purple. They are made by mixing just two primary colors together!
copy.tl: Ang mga secondary na kulay ay berde, kahel, at lila. Sila ay nabubuo sa pamamagitan ng paghalo ng dalawang primaryong kulay!
copy.bis: Ang mga secondary nga kolor mao ang berde, kahel, ug lila. Kini mabuhat pinaagi sa pagsagol sa duha ka panguna nga kolor!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Before a typhoon, secure loose outdoor items
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how different factors affect the solubility of a solute in a given solvent, such as heat
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about typhoon preparedness (securing loose objects), not about factors affecting solubility of a solute in a solvent. No instructional support for solubility.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Before a typhoon, secure loose outdoor items
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe that particles are constantly in motion, have spaces between them, attract each other, and move faster as the temperature increases (or with the addition of heat)
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses securing objects before a typhoon; it does not describe particle motion, spacing, attraction, or temperature effects on particles.

assignedReviews.reason: The card does not address the Particle Model of Matter or the idea that matter is made of tiny particles. It is about typhoon safety.

copy.en: Before a typhoon, secure loose outdoor items like roof sheets, branches, and furniture so strong winds cannot throw them.
copy.tl: Bago dumating ang bagyo, itali o iligpit ang mga maluwag na bagay sa labas tulad ng yero, sanga, at kasangkapan para hindi ito liparin ng malakas na hangin.
copy.bis: Sa dili pa moabot ang bagyo, ihigot o hipusa ang mga luag nga butang sa gawas sama sa yero, sanga, ug kasangkapan aron dili kini paliron sa kusog nga hangin.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: continues to grow taller and stronger in sunlight
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out guided investigations to describe and illustrate the reflection of light using plane and curved mirrors and the refraction of light using transparent blocks, lenses, and prisms with examples from everyday applications
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes seedling growth after germination, a biology topic. G8-F-11 requires guided investigations on reflection and refraction of light using mirrors, lenses, and prisms. The mention of sunlight is incidental and does not support any aspect of the competency.

copy.en: After germination, the seed becomes a seedling, which is a young plant with a tiny stem and leaves that continues to grow taller and stronger in sunlight.
copy.tl: Pagkatapos ng germination, ang buto ay nagiging seedling, na isang batang halaman na may maliit na tangkay at dahon na patuloy na lumalaki at tumitibay sa sikat ng araw.
copy.bis: Pagkahuman sa germination, ang liso mahimong seedling, nga usa ka batan-on nga tanom nga adunay gagmay nga punoan ug dahon nga padayon nga motubo ug molig-on sa kahayag sa adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When we compare weather observations across several days, we can see patterns
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that genetic information is passed on to offspring from both parents by the process of meiosis and fertilization
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses weather patterns and temperature changes, which is unrelated to genetic information, meiosis, or fertilization. The competency is about inheritance and cell division, not meteorology.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When we compare weather observations across several days, we can see patterns
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that cells reproduce through two types of cell division, mitosis and meiosis, and describe mitosis as cell division for growth and repair
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about observing weather patterns, not about cell reproduction, mitosis, or meiosis. No content supports the competency.

copy.en: When we compare weather observations across several days, we can see patterns, like temperatures getting warmer each afternoon.
copy.tl: Kapag ikinumpara natin ang mga obserbasyon sa panahon sa loob ng ilang araw, makikita natin ang mga pattern, tulad ng pag-init ng temperature tuwing hapon.
copy.bis: Kung atong ikumpara ang mga obserbasyon sa panahon sa pipila ka adlaw, makita nato ang mga pattern, sama sa pag-init sa temperature matag hapon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Selection means placing organisms under conditions where the growth of those with a particular genotype, or set of genes, will be favored.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines selection in genetics/evolution, which is unrelated to the competency on photosynthesis and respiration, their raw materials, and products.

copy.en: Selection means placing organisms under conditions where the growth of those with a particular genotype, or set of genes, will be favored.
copy.tl: Ang selection ay nangangahulugang paglalagay sa mga organism sa mga kondisyon kung saan ang paglaki ng mga may partikular na genotype, o set ng genes, ay magiging mas pinapaboran.
copy.bis: Ang selection nagpasabot nga ibutang ang mga organismo sa mga kondisyon diin ang pagtubo sa mga adunay partikular nga genotype, o set sa genes, paboran.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In 1880, Thomas Edison's company, the Edison Electric Light Company, began marketing and selling his new incandescent light bulb.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out guided investigations to describe and illustrate the reflection of light using plane and curved mirrors and the refraction of light using transparent blocks, lenses, and prisms with examples from everyday applications
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires guided investigations describing and illustrating reflection and refraction of light using mirrors, lenses, and prisms. The card only states that Edison's company began marketing and selling the incandescent light bulb; it contains no physics content about light behavior, reflection, or refraction. The shared word 'light' is insufficient.

copy.en: In 1880, Thomas Edison's company, the Edison Electric Light Company, began marketing and selling his new incandescent light bulb.
copy.tl: Noong 1880, ang kompanya ni Thomas Edison, ang Edison Electric Light Company, ay nagsimulang mag-market at magbenta ng kaniyang bagong incandescent light bulb.
copy.bis: Sa 1880, ang kompanya ni Thomas Edison, ang Edison Electric Light Company, nagsugod sa pag-market ug pagbaligya sa iyang bag-ong incandescent light bulb.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Our senses help us describe objects by seeing their color, feeling their texture, smelling their scent, tasting their flavor, and hearing their sound!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that changes in materials can be harmful to living and non-living things in the environment, such as trash disposal, and burning household materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches using senses to describe physical characteristics of objects. It does not address changes in materials being harmful to living/non-living things, trash disposal, or burning household materials.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Our senses help us describe objects by seeing their color, feeling their texture, smelling their scent, tasting their flavor, and hearing their sound!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how interaction between living things and interactions between living and non-living things may bring good or harm to the living things involved
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about sensory description of objects, not about interactions between living things or between living and non-living things bringing good or harm.

copy.en:
How do we describe the physical characteristics of objects?

Our senses help us describe objects by seeing their color, feeling their texture, smelling their scent, tasting their flavor, and hearing their sound!
copy.tl:
Paano natin nailalarawan ang mga katangian ng mga bagay?

Ang ating mga pandama ay tumutulong upang mailarawan ang mga bagay sa pamamagitan ng pagtingin sa kulay, paghawak sa tekstura, pag-amoy sa bango, pagtikim sa lasa, at pakikinig sa tunog!
copy.bis:
Giunsa nato paghulagway ang mga kinaiya sa mga butang?

Ang atong mga senses makatabang sa paghulagway sa mga butang pinaagi sa pagtan-aw sa kolor, paghikap sa texture, pagsimhot sa baho, pagtilaw sa lami, ug pagpaminaw sa tingog!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The external sex organs are very sensitive, and lack of proper care for them can result in discomfort and even illness.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify solutions, which can be found at home and in school and that react with litmus indicator, as acids, bases, and salts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses sensitivity and care of external sex organs, which is a health/reproductive topic. It provides no information about solutions, litmus indicators, acids, bases, or salts, so it does not support the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The external sex organs are very sensitive, and lack of proper care for them can result in discomfort and even illness.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify common acids, bases, and salts (e.g., hydrochloric acid, sodium hydroxide, and saline solution) using different indicators
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about reproductive organ care, not about identifying common acids, bases, or salts using indicators. There is no chemistry content relevant to this competency.

copy.en: The external sex organs are very sensitive, and lack of proper care for them can result in discomfort and even illness.
copy.tl: Ang external sex organs ay napakasensitibo, at ang kawalan ng wastong pag-aalaga dito ay maaaring magdulot ng discomfort at maging ng sakit.
copy.bis: Ang external sex organs sensitibo kaayo, ug ang kakulang sa husto nga pag-atiman kanila mahimong moresulta sa kahasol ug bisan sa sakit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A parallel circuit gives each device its own separate path or branch
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different types of volcanoes found around the world according to their: a. activity b. type of eruption c. location in the crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about parallel circuits in electricity, not about volcanoes, eruption types, or crustal location. No support for the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A parallel circuit gives each device its own separate path or branch
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: relate the shape of a volcano's cone to its composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses circuit branches, not volcano cone shape or composition. Entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: A parallel circuit gives each device its own separate path or branch, so the current can flow through many loops at the same time.
copy.tl: Ang parallel circuit ay nagbibigay sa bawat device ng sarili nitong path o branch, kaya ang current ay maaaring dumaloy sa maraming loop nang sabay-sabay.
copy.bis: Ang parallel circuit maghatag sa matag device ug kaugalingon nga path o branch, busa ang current makaagos sa daghang loop sa samang higayon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: We separate mixtures in the kitchen every day
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about separating mixtures (sieving, filtering, hand picking) in daily kitchen activities. G3-L-5 requires observing the outer parts of plants (leaves, roots, stems) and identifying their role in getting water and nutrients. The card provides no information about plant parts or their functions, so it does not support this competency.

copy.en: We separate mixtures in the kitchen every day, like sieving rice from palay, filtering juice from seeds, or hand picking ingredients we do not want from our food.
copy.tl: Naghihiwalay tayo ng mga mixture sa kusina araw-araw, tulad ng pagsasala ng bigas mula sa palay, pagsasala ng juice mula sa mga buto, o pagpili gamit ang kamay ng mga sangkap na ayaw natin sa ating pagkain.
copy.bis: Magbulag kita og mga mixture sa kusina kada adlaw, sama sa pagsala sa bugas gikan sa palay, pagsala sa juice sa mga liso, o pagpili gamit ang kamot sa mga sangkap nga dili nato gusto sa atong pagkaon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In a series circuit, all loads are difficult to control individually, because one switch controls the entire single pathway.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses series circuits and switch control, which is an electricity/physics topic. G5-L-7 is about specialized structures in plants (rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, aerial roots). There is no connection to plant structures or any living-things content.

copy.en: In a series circuit, all loads are difficult to control individually, because one switch controls the entire single pathway.
copy.tl: Sa series circuit, mahirap kontrolin nang isa-isa ang mga load, dahil isang switch lang ang kumokontrol sa buong nag-iisang daanan.
copy.bis: Sa series circuit, lisod kontrolon nga tagsa-tagsa ang mga load, tungod kay usa ra ka switch ang nagkontrol sa tibuok usa ka agianan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Color blindness and hemophilia are sex-linked recessive disorders, meaning the genes for them are on the X chromosome.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses sex-linked recessive genetic disorders (color blindness, hemophilia) and the X chromosome, which is a genetics/biology topic. G6-M-4 requires describing useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions. There is no connection to mixtures, solutions, or suspensions.

copy.en: Color blindness and hemophilia are sex-linked recessive disorders, meaning the genes for them are on the X chromosome.
copy.tl: Ang color blindness at hemophilia ay mga sex-linked recessive disorder, ibig sabihin ang mga gene para dito ay nasa X chromosome.
copy.bis: Ang color blindness ug hemophilia kay mga sex-linked recessive disorder, nagpasabot nga ang mga gene para ani naa sa X chromosome.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A shallower focus causes more destruction because its seismic waves lose less energy before reaching the surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the roles of producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers in a food web
assignedReviews.reason: Earthquake focus depth is unrelated to producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers in a food web.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A shallower focus causes more destruction because its seismic waves lose less energy before reaching the surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: Earthquake focus depth is unrelated to photosynthesis and respiration and their raw materials and products.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A shallower focus causes more destruction because its seismic waves lose less energy before reaching the surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the trophic levels of an organism as levels of energy in a food pyramid
assignedReviews.reason: Earthquake focus depth is unrelated to trophic levels as levels of energy in a food pyramid.

copy.en:
Why are some earthquakes more destructive than others of the same strength?

A shallower focus causes more destruction because its seismic waves lose less energy before reaching the surface.
copy.tl:
Bakit mas mapanira ang ilang lindol kaysa iba na pareho lang ang lakas?

Ang mas mababaw na focus ay nagdudulot ng mas maraming pinsala dahil ang seismic waves nito ay hindi gaanong nawawalan ng energy bago makarating sa surface.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga mas makadaot ang uban nga linog kaysa sa uban nga pareho ra og kusog?

Ang mas mabaw nga focus makapahinabog mas daghang kadaot tungod kay ang seismic waves niini dili kaayo mawad-an og energy sa dili pa makaabot sa surface.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tectonic activities, like the slow movement of plates, are responsible for shaping Earth's geological features such as mountains and volcanoes
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the circulatory system as heart, blood, and blood vessels, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: Plate tectonics are unrelated to identifying heart, blood, and blood vessels.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the slow movement of plates, are responsible for shaping Earth's geological features
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: Tectonics are unrelated to the five body systems.

copy.en: Tectonic activities, like the slow movement of plates, are responsible for shaping Earth's geological features such as mountains and volcanoes.
copy.tl: Ang mga tectonic activity, tulad ng mabagal na paggalaw ng mga plate, ang responsable sa paghubog ng mga geological feature ng Earth tulad ng mga bundok at bulkan.
copy.bis: Ang mga tectonic activity, sama sa hinay nga paglihok sa mga plate, maoy responsable sa pagporma sa mga geological feature sa Earth sama sa mga bukid ug bulkan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sharing a fact-checkable post is more powerful
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of everyday situations that demonstrate: a. kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy, and b. potential energy being transformed to kinetic energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses sharing social media posts about climate change; it contains no content about kinetic energy transforming to potential energy or vice versa.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sharing a fact-checkable post is more powerful
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe kinetic energy as the movement of objects or particles, and potential energy as energy stored due to the position of objects or particles
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about information sharing and climate change awareness, not about kinetic energy as movement or potential energy as stored energy.

copy.en:
Should I just like a social media post about climate change?

Sharing a fact-checkable post is more powerful because it spreads the information to more people and helps them learn too!
copy.tl:
Dapat ko bang i-like lang ang isang social media post tungkol sa climate change?

Mas makapangyarihan ang pag-share ng fact-checkable na post dahil ikinakalat nito ang impormasyon sa mas maraming tao at natutulungan din silang matuto!
copy.bis:
Angay ba nako nga i-like lang ang usa ka social media post mahitungod sa climate change?

Mas gamhanan ang pag-share sa fact-checkable nga post tungod kay gipakaylap kini ang impormasyon sa mas daghang tawo ug makatabang usab kanila nga makakat-on!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about communicating research findings and receiving input on conclusion validity. It has no connection to separating mixtures (decantation, winnowing, filtering, etc.).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the research can be presented to others to inform them of the findings
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the benefits of each mixture separation technique in preparing useful products
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses presenting research conclusions, not explaining benefits of mixture separation techniques in preparing useful products.

copy.en: When a conclusion is drawn, the research can be presented to others to inform them of the findings and receive input about the validity of the conclusion.
copy.tl: Kapag may conclusion na, ang research ay maaaring i-present sa iba para ipaalam ang mga natuklasan at makatanggap ng puna tungkol sa validity ng conclusion.
copy.bis: Kung aduna nay conclusion, ang research mahimong i-present sa uban aron ipahibalo ang mga nakit-an ug makadawat og komento mahitungod sa validity sa conclusion.
